findings.claim: The mirror check does not enforce that each source skill is listed in exactly one SOURCES.json category, so a skill duplicated across project, thirdParty, and generated can pass contrary to the scenario.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criterion “Every source skill is classified” requires a directory with SKILL.md to be “listed in exactly one of project, thirdParty or generated, or the mirror check fails naming it”; the implementation builds `known = new Set([...sources.project, ...Object.keys(sources.thirdParty), ...sources.generated])` and only reports skills not in that union, which collapses duplicates instead of failing them.
findings.suggested_fix: Build a per-skill classification count across project, thirdParty, and generated, and fail --check/non-check when any `.agents/skills/*/SKILL.md` has count !== 1, naming duplicated and unclassified skills separately.

findings.claim: The build-order documentation says the Anthropic healthcare plugin is “enabled for Claude,” contradicting the per-user opt-in/not-project-enabled requirement.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criterion 2.1 says `healthcare@healthcare` is “per-user opt-in, not enabled at project scope,” while the README build-order row for `install-domain-skills` says “Anthropic's healthcare plugin enabled for Claude (not copied into the repo).”
findings.suggested_fix: Change the row to say the marketplace is registered for Claude and the plugin remains per-user opt-in/not enabled at project scope.
